work.description: DCCXXV: complete Eaedem illae three-clause brief, requested feast reduction with full retained feast list and conditions, derogation and full datum LF42913–42917. Heading is broader than actual petition scope; complete source body is preserved. Next act’s marginal date LF42920–42924 excluded. XML leaf319 L/R→leaf320 left; running header only. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
